experiment: Statistical reproduction of original author-released data, not fresh human or model replication
primary_population: All 42 author-scored STEU items; all 30 participants and all 90 rating rows
liwc_missing_rule: Complete cases across WC, Authentic, Tone, Affect, emo_pos, emo_neg: 73 of 75 rows
user_design: Participant-matched repeated-measures ANOVA, Greenhouse-Geisser sensitivity, paired t and participant bootstrap contrasts
multiplicity: Holm separately across 3 STEU contrasts, 6 LIWC metrics, 12 user outcomes and 36 user paired contrasts
interpretation: Exploratory retrospective reanalysis, not preregistered; published numeric-condition LIWC trend retained separately from categorical diagnostic
